Posted my score (6.5) and attached a short note with observations. Main callouts:
- Strength: solid system decomposition and clear tradeoffs in latency vs consistency.
- Concern: coding fluency under time pressure — tended to sketch rather than implement details; I worry about ramp time.

Options I recommend:
1) Short take-home (2-3 hour exercise) focused on implementing a small endpoint + test — would give us direct signal on coding approach.
2) If we prefer lower friction, a focused 60-min follow-up with a SWE who covers implementation depth.

Either way, I don't see a hard blocker — leaning take-home to reduce risk.
